command:
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/workspace")
old = root / "p24-kernel-exception-smoke-20261126" / "attempt-001"
out = root / "p24-kernel-exception-owned-20261126" / "attempt-001"
lean = Path("/workspace/toolchains/lean-4.33.0-rc1-linux/bin/lean")
expected_lean_hash = "e8baaa71855a616dc351028f3ad2200051b0671f423a1696a100e809302d5550"
expected_smoke_hash = "df56fea377ce6dbb6e164a4bd1edfa0d6df2e82b53902f99ae90ff046fe8b529"
expected_audit_hash = "298d7688c910d541b0b915470c844126febcc59b4c07684c6c88de076211361b"

def digest(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def old_snapshot():
    return {str(p.relative_to(old)): digest(p) for p in sorted(old.rglob("*")) if p.is_file()}

assert old.is_dir()
assert digest(old / "Smoke.lean") == expected_smoke_hash
assert (old / "Smoke.olean").is_file()
assert digest(lean) == expected_lean_hash
version = subprocess.check_output([str(lean), "--version"], text=True).strip()
assert "62eed1db4d67327ec8120be05f1a1b0847d74561" in version
assert os.statvfs(root).f_bavail * os.statvfs(root).f_frsize >= 64 * 1024 * 1024
before = old_snapshot()
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
source = out / "OwnedAudit.lean"
source.write_bytes(base64.b64decode("", validate=True))
assert digest(source) == expected_audit_hash
env = dict(os.environ)
env["LEAN_PATH"] = str(root)
flags = ["-t0", "-j1", "-M4096", "-DwarningAsError=true",
         "-DmaxRecDepth=50000", "-DmaxHeartbeats=40000000"]
command = [str(lean), *flags, "-R", str(root), "-o",
           str(out / "OwnedAudit.olean"), str(source)]
print(json.dumps({
    "diagnostic_only": True,
    "compile_credit": False, "kernel_credit": False,
    "acceptance_credit": False, "finite_A_credit": False,
    "full_owned_audit_credit": False,
    "scope": "complete existing P1 smoke module owned declarations only",
    "module": "«p24-kernel-exception-smoke-20261126».«attempt-001».Smoke",
    "existing_smoke_source": str(old / "Smoke.lean"),
    "existing_smoke_olean": str(old / "Smoke.olean"),
    "smoke_source_sha256": expected_smoke_hash,
    "smoke_artifacts_before": before,
    "lean_version": version, "lean_sha256": expected_lean_hash,
    "audit_source_sha256": expected_audit_hash,
    "command": command, "child_timeout_seconds": 120
}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)

log = out / "owned-audit.log"
started = time.monotonic()
timed_out = False
with log.open("wb") as stream:
    proc = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=root, env=env,
                            stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    try:
        rc = proc.wait(timeout=120)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timed_out = True
        proc.kill()
        rc = proc.wait()
elapsed = time.monotonic() - started
raw = log.read_bytes()
sys.stdout.buffer.write(raw)
sys.stdout.buffer.flush()
after = old_snapshot()
unchanged = before == after
summaries = []
inventories = []
records = []
for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
    if line.startswith("P24_SMOKE_OWNED_SUMMARY "):
        summaries.append(json.loads(line.split(" ", 1)[1]))
    elif line.startswith("P24_SMOKE_OWNED_INVENTORY "):
        inventories.append(json.loads(line.split(" ", 1)[1]))
    elif line.startswith("P24_SMOKE_OWNED_DECL "):
        records.append(json.loads(line.split(" ", 1)[1]))
if rc == 0:
    assert len(summaries) == len(inventories) == 1
    assert summaries[0]["inventory_complete"]
    assert summaries[0]["all_owned_rules_passed"]
    assert summaries[0]["owned_count"] == len(records)
    assert sorted(r["name"] for r in records) == sorted(inventories[0]["serialized"])
    assert all(not r["violates_original_owned_rules"] for r in records)
result = {
    "diagnostic_only": True,
    "compile_credit": False, "kernel_credit": False,
    "acceptance_credit": False, "finite_A_credit": False,
    "full_owned_audit_credit": False,
    "scope": "complete existing P1 smoke module owned declarations only",
    "exit_code": rc, "timed_out": timed_out, "child_elapsed_seconds": elapsed,
    "smoke_artifacts_before": before, "smoke_artifacts_after": after,
    "existing_smoke_artifacts_unchanged": unchanged,
    "canonical_P2_touched": False, "existing_P1_project_touched": False,
    "lean_sha256": expected_lean_hash,
    "audit_source_sha256": expected_audit_hash,
    "log_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "log_bytes": len(raw),
    "inventory_records": inventories, "owned_summary_records": summaries,
    "owned_records_count": len(records),
    "rejected_records": [r for r in records if r["violates_original_owned_rules"]]
}
(out / "diagnostic.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
assert unchanged, "Existing smoke artifacts changed"
raise SystemExit(rc if rc >= 0 else 1)
